rationale: Describes end-to-end wireless/fixed-line service testing, measurement, and performance monitoring with automated remote monitoring, conventional network operations functionality.
evidence_spans:
With our powerful network testing and measurement software, TEMS Sense, you can implement automated, remote monitoring of service performance from a variety of locations. Using comprehensive active service testing capabilities, TEMS Sense provides complete end-to-end service performance visibility so you can avoid potential issues.

TEMS™ Monitor Master 8.4 is a carrier-grade software and hardware solution designed to test and monitor the end-to-end quality and user-experience of wireless and fixed line services.
